intended_object: Per the docstring and name: a proper γ-colouring of the disjoint union G ⊕ H restricted to the vertices of G, which gives a proper colouring of G. This is the composite c ∘ inl.
explanation: The definition composes the colouring c (a graph homomorphism from G ⊕g H to the complete graph on γ) with the canonical embedding G ↪g G ⊕g H through the left summand. The result is exactly the colouring v ↦ c (inl v) of G. It is stated for arbitrary vertex types and an arbitrary colour type, so no generality is lost. The surrounding lemmas behave as expected for a restriction to the left component: `sumLeft_sum` shows it undoes `Coloring.sum`, and the file builds an equivalence from it together with `sumRight`.
